component: persistent reasoning signing key and mlx2 coding-agent launcher
modifications: clients.py: kept the Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode argv/environment construction; dropped Hermes (it writes a profile file); renamed the provider and key variable to mlx2/MLX2_API_KEY; the key is an explicit argument; OpenCode image input follows the served model's vision capability instead of always on; Claude Code also receives CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL and the four newer provider switches found in Claude Code 2.1.269.

cli.py: replaced Splash's local status probe with GET /v1/models (model) and GET /v1/status (max_context) against --url/MLX2_URL, sending the API key as a bearer token; launcher options precede the agent name.

reasoning_signatures.py: adopted the temporary-file plus os.link publication and owner/mode checks from load_thinking_key for an HMAC secret; no Fernet/cryptography dependency, tokens stay signed, not encrypted.
server.py: the key defaults to <api-state-dir>/reasoning-signing.key only when --api-state-dir is set and no key source is configured; --reasoning-signing-ephemeral opts out.
